recommended_contingency_crops.name: Short-Duration Paddy (MTU-1010 / Lalat)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: MTU-1010 matures in 110 days and is CRIDA-recommended for delayed sowing in Odisha red laterite soils. High tolerance to moisture stress.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Arhar / Pigeonpea (UPAS-120 / ICPL-87119)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Deep tap root system tolerates dry spells; nitrogen-fixing; suitable for red laterite. Widely grown by tribal communities in Sundargarh.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Finger Millet / Ragi (VL-149 / GPU-28)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Extremely drought-tolerant; staple food crop for tribal households; low input requirement.

agronomic_measures: Adopt direct seeded rice (DSR) to save 2-3 weeks; apply soil conservation furrows; use short-duration varieties with wide row spacing 30cm x 10cm.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Green Gram / Moong (PDM-139 / Samrat)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Very short 60-65 day cycle; captures residual soil moisture; high protein value for subsistence tribal farmers.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Cowpea (Pusa Komal / V-16)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Grows well in poor sandy loam soils with minimal irrigation; nitrogen fixer; provides food security.

agronomic_measures: Use raised bed planting to improve drainage; apply organic mulch 5 t/ha; supplemental irrigation if available within 3-4 weeks of sowing.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Short-duration Maize (Vivek-9 / HQPM-1)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Early maturing hybrid with high stress tolerance; recommended by ICAR for delayed sowing in Jharkhand-Odisha belt.

recommended_contingency_crops.name: Arhar / Pigeonpea (UPAS-120)
recommended_contingency_crops.rationale: Alternative to maize when rainfall is insufficient for long-duration crops.

agronomic_measures: Widen inter-row spacing to 60cm; apply straw mulch; foliar spray 2% urea during vegetative stress.
